$note: What names an instrument family, when its row's name is a mechanical
re-casing of its own id.
Publishability asks whether a row has CHILDREN, not whether it is a FUND.
Eleven childless bucket labels passed it and reached founders' menus:
`SATR Pt Equity` landed unblocked in a Portuguese founder's 18-row pool,
rendered as "National state aid (equity)" with a typical award of EUR
255,571, and Poland's ENTIRE offerable pool was eight `Sudop *` rows -- no
real Polish fund was in it. None of the eleven carries a scheme code, an
application URL or a register name. It went unseen because no bench
archetype covers EE, LT, PT or PL.
A ROW MAY BE OFFERED ONLY IF SOMETHING OUTSIDE ITS OWN ID NAMES IT.
The test for an unseen row: point at the field in the source record, or the
official publication, the name was read from. If the loader assembled it
from its own partition keys, it is a bucket and not a fund.
── Why declared here and not inferred at read time ──────────────────────
Inference was tried and it over-fired: `name_source = 'deterministic'`
catches 372 rows, and 'the name is a mechanical re-casing of the id' catches
94 -- including the eleven IPCEI waves, the eight Innovation Fund lots and
every Horizon cluster, which are real funds whose slug happens to be
recoverable from a published identifier. Nothing READABLE FROM THE ROW
separates `horizon_eu_cl4` (CORDIS's own topic-code prefix) from
`satr_pt_equity` (a country crossed with the filter set we send to a search
API). The distinction lives in the EXTRACTOR, so it is recorded where it is
known -- the same reason source_window_policy.json exists.
`id_prefix` matches families whose id starts with it; `id` matches exactly
and wins over any prefix. A family whose name is a mechanical re-casing and
that matches nothing here FAILS THE LOAD -- silence is the one forbidden
state, because the families that will hurt are the ones nobody enumerated.
Families named from anywhere else (a curated override, the state-aid case
register, a programme feed, the granting authority on the award, the NDB
label registry) never reach this file: they already point at their source.
source_field          the distinguishing token IS a field of the fetched
record, re-labelled by us. `field` names it.
official_publication  a human read the body's own decision or product page
and transcribed the object's name. `publication`
cites it.
partition_key         nothing outside our own query partitioning produced
it. NOT A FUND. Withheld from every founder's pool.
Every entry carries `source`, a file:line or a URL, so a reader in a year
can check the claim instead of trusting it.

declarations.reason: The id is <register>_<country>_<filter family>. The country is a register field (load_satr.py:340, the award's granting country) but the third token is not: it is which of the two filter sets we sent to the register's own search -- EQUITY_SHORTCODE 'equity' / RND_SHORTCODE 'rnd', ETL/lib/satr_filters.py:181-182 -- read back out of the cache filename WE wrote (extract_satr.py:253-256, recovered by load_satr.py:296-299). The State Aid Transparency Register publishes no object called 'Estonia equity'. Its objects are notified schemes with SA numbers, and those are already the CHILDREN of these rows.

The slug is field 2 of the hand-written INNOVATION_MEASURES tuples -- 'bgk_kit_v3', 'parp_rd' -- one per query we run against UOKiK's SUDOP API. Field 1 of the same tuple is the OFFICIAL identifier, the SA number ('SA.60606(2020/X)'), and it is used as the query key and then discarded before `source` is composed. `sudop_rnd_purpose` is not even in that list: it is the residual of fetch_by_purpose_codes(), a partition of a partition. The route back to real Polish funds is to carry those SA numbers into scheme_code and name the rows from the state aid case register, exactly as the SATR children are named.

'unknown' is our fallback in _topic_year() for a CORDIS topic code carrying no -20YY- segment (extract_cordis_pillar_ii.py:183-185). It is a parse outcome, not a programme: the awards belong to the same Joint Undertaking as `chips_ju_kdt`, which stays offerable, so nothing is lost by withholding a row whose name reads 'Chips JU KDT Unknown'.

declarations.decided: 2026-11-06, by the platform owner's delegated technical decision: the instrument was already curated as 'Innovate UK' (name_source=curated, 17,012 awards); this declaration only states why, so the rebuild stops refusing.
